name: Peridot
description: (Tag:golem)(Tag:mechanic)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:tech)(Tech)(Character)A second-era Peridot engineer-caste gem with incredible Gem Empire engineering knowledge to build droids, warp pads, and more given resources and time, plus formidable ferrokinesis despite meagre physical stats. As a second-era gem she cannot shapeshift, and the tinkertech level she can build scales with your power.
